description: A small digital assistant for Ma's Corner Store: greeting, hours, stock, refunds, recommendations, chit-chat. The demo quilt for quilt-softjoints — decomposition splits its behavior into lookups (formulaic), softjoints (small models reading the moment as a vector), and greeters (deliberately never decomposed).

backend.prompt_template: You are the greeter of Ma's Corner Store, a small neighborhood shop. A customer walks in. Customer name on file: {{customer_name}}. They say: "{{customer_text}}". Greet them in one short, warm sentence. Do not upsell. Sound like a person, not a policy.

fallback.note: even the greeter degrades gracefully: a fixed warm line when every channel is dark
fallback.value: Welcome in! Baskets are by the door — I'm around if you need anything.

cells.notes: GREETER (deliberately NEVER decomposed): GREETER: the welcome IS the product. The principal's line: in a fully automated general store you'd still have humans as greeters — part of the checkout process is the human connection. No table can hold warmth; decomposing this cell would delete the feature it exists for.

backend.prompt_template: You are the owner of Ma's Corner Store, chatting with a neighbor at the counter. Name on file: {{customer_name}}. They say: "{{customer_text}}". Reply in one warm, short sentence like you've known them for years.

fallback.note: graceful degradation: a friendly deflection when the model channel is dark
fallback.value: Ha — tell me more over by the coffee shelf, it's fresh today.

cells.notes: GREETER (deliberately NEVER decomposed): GREETER: chit-chat is connection maintenance, not an information lookup. Its value is that a human chose to talk; routing it through a table would end the conversation. Deliberately never decomposed.

cells.default: Hours vary on holidays — call us at 555-0134.
cells.notes: a closed day-of-week mapping: pure table, no model, no vector

cells.default: Let me walk back and check for you.

backend.prompt_template: You handle refunds at Ma's Corner Store. The customer says: "{{customer_text}}". Name on file: {{customer_name}}. Base policy (may be overridden by judgment): {{refund.base}}. Pick exactly ONE action for this moment.

criteria.refund to card: money back to the original payment
criteria.store credit: credit for a future purchase — the default goodwill move

fallback.note: graceful degradation when the model call fails or the budget is out: the bucket rows are cooled-out answers, the default is plain policy

cells.notes: stays dynamic: intent declares 3 corner case(s) that need judgment over the moment, not a fixed row of a table (spec classify hint agrees)

table.urgency:hi,familiarity:lo,sentiment:lo,f: Deep breath — I've got you. Store credit in two minutes, no forms.

cells.default: Store policy: 30 days with a receipt, store credit without. Let me make this right for you.
cells.notes: graceful degradation when the model call fails or the budget is out: the bucket rows are cooled-out answers, the default is plain policy

backend.prompt_template: You recommend one item at Ma's Corner Store. Customer says: "{{customer_text}}". Name on file: {{customer_name}}. Stock hints: {{stock.lookup}}. Recommend exactly one item in one short sentence, off the mood of the moment.

fallback.note: graceful degradation when the model call fails or the budget is out

cells.notes: stays dynamic: policies are worded as judgment calls ("always offer... when...") — a lookup cannot rank them against the moment (spec classify hint agrees)

table.urgency:lo,familiarity:hi,sentiment:hi,f: Day-old doughnuts are half price — you know you want them.

cells.default: Can't go wrong with the day-old doughnuts — half price after 2pm.
cells.notes: graceful degradation when the model call fails or the budget is out
